supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: visible lateral extension beyond the outer ocular boundaries

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: pronounced contrast with a lighter muzzle area relative to the high-intensity/darker periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin 2D vertical profile with a neutral, linear resting position

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: numerous dark pigmentation spots (freckling) across the muzzle area
other_distinctive_markers: extensive cranial balding on the frontal and parietal regions
